SELECT 
    RAWTOHEX(t.TERMINAL_ID)      AS TERMINAL_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(t.POS_CONDITION_ID) AS POS_CONDITION_ID,

    p.TERMINAL_TYPE_DESC,
    p.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID           AS TERMINAL_TYPE_ID,

    pc.POS_CONDITION,

    RAWTOHEX(t.MCC_ID)           AS MCC_ID,
    m.CATEGORY_MCC_MDR           AS MCC

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL t

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL_TYPE p
    ON p.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID = t.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_POS_CONDITION pc
    ON pc.CONDITION_ID = t.POS_CONDITION_ID

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MCC_MDR_VW m
    ON m.MCC_ID = t.MCC_ID

WHERE t.REQUEST_ID =
      HEXTORAW(
          REPLACE(
              '{{JS_ADD_TERMINAL.getRequestId()}}',
              '-',
              ''
          )
      )
  AND t.IS_DELETED = 0

ORDER BY t.CREATED_AT
